newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ residential building trend jumps in March qtr.
newsitem.headline: NZ residential building trend jumps in March qtr.

text.p: The value of all building work put in place in the March quarter was NZ$1.625 billion, 9.8 percent more than the $1.48 billion recorded for the March 1996 quarter, Statistics New Zealand said on Friday.
The trend estimate for the value of non-residential building work put in place fell 0.5 percent from the December 1996 quarter, extending a downtrend seen in the previous quarter.
In contrast, the trend estimate for the value of work put in place on residential buildings rose by 3.1 percent in the quarter compared with the preceding three-month period.
SNZ said work worth $970 million was put in place on residential buildings in the quarter, an increase of 15.8 percent from the figure for the March 1996 quarter.
The $654.6 million worth of work put in place on non-residential buildings in the quarter was 2.1 percent more than in the year-ago quarter.
